description: A lab-local authentication bypass: the admin panel accepts a request with a forged session cookie.

evidence.response: 200 OK, admin panel with lab user list
evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; the forged cookie is a lab test value

impact: An unauthenticated attacker could administer the lab.
proof_of_concept: GET /lab/admin with Cookie: lab-session=forged returns 200 with the admin panel; the response lists lab users.
remediation: Verify the session cookie against the server session store on every admin request.
steps_to_reproduce: Request https://lab.local/admin with a forged lab-session cookie
Observe the admin panel in the response
title: Authentication bypass on lab admin panel
